# TokenBridge - Design tokens export

Generated design tokens for: **Web, Flutter**

## 📦 Installation

```bash
npm ci
```

## 🚀 Build Tokens

Run the build script to generate platform-specific token files:

```bash
npm run build
```

## 📁 Output Structure Example

```
build/
├── web/
│   ├── primitives.css
│   ├── theme-light.css
│   └── theme-dark.css
├── flutter/
│   ├── primitives.dart
│   ├── semantics.dart
│   └── components.dart
```
